biggest_catch: Referrers are capped at three referrals ($300) per calendar year, and the friend's account must stay open 45 days before the $100 is paid.
catches: $100 to the referrer and $100 to the friend per qualifying referral.
Referrers may earn up to $300 in rewards per calendar year, based on a maximum of three (3) valid referrals.
Friend must: open primary savings ($5 minimum), open Value/Lifestyle Checking, enroll in online banking, keep the checking open at least 45 days.
Friend must use the same email address as provided at the time of referral; both must be 18+ and not have caused a loss to the CU.
Reward delivered via email within four (4) weeks after verification of all qualifying actions.
Youth and business accounts do not qualify; promotional offer subject to change or termination at any time.

steps: Enter the email associated with your Alabama CU account to generate your unique referral link.
Send the link to friends and family.
Your friend opens a savings + qualifying checking account and enrolls in online banking.
Both receive $100 within four weeks after the account is open 45 days.
timing: Reward delivered via email within four weeks after all qualifying actions verified.
when_cash_arrives: Reward delivered via email within four weeks after all qualifying actions verified. Roughly a month from the trigger event to cash in hand.
maximize: Trigger the clock early: have your friend complete qualifying activity (direct deposit, debit transactions) in the first days of the window.
Route a real payroll direct deposit (not Zelle/P2P transfers, which most programs exclude) as early as possible - payroll timing is usually the gating step.
If any-amount direct deposit qualifies, a small recurring ACH can trigger it - check the program's 'qualifying deposit' definition first.
Structural reason it cannot be faster: the payout window itself is 3-4 weeks after qualification - there is no expedited track.
